name: Gran Melia Arusha
positioning: Five-star Gran Meliá hotel among coffee and tea plantations on the edge of Arusha, with Mount Meru views and guided excursions to northern Tanzania's parks
best_for: Travelers starting or ending a northern Tanzania safari who want a hotel base in Arusha
Couples wanting a Mount Meru view suite with RedLevel butler service

facts.text: The hotel is located between the Serengeti and Kilimanjaro National Parks.
The hotel is 5 km from the Arusha city center.
Rooms are decorated with motifs inspired by local Tanzanian tribes, in the colors of local coffee beans.
The RedLevel Junior Suite has a balcony with views of Mount Meru and Arusha National Park, and a lounge separate from the bedroom.
The Presidential Suite is on the top floor of the hotel, with large windows and pool views.
RedLevel guests get a private check-in in the RedLevel Lounge and a personalized butler service on request.
The Roof Top on the hotel's top floor looks out to Mount Meru and serves tapas, dishes to share and creative cocktails, indoors and on the terrace.
The Pool Bar is surrounded by the hotel's tea and coffee plantations, with Mount Meru as a backdrop.
The hotel offers a guided trek on Mount Meru, an active volcano of 4,566 metres.
A half-day trip to Arusha National Park explores the Montane forest and the Ngurdoto Crater.
A day safari to Tarangire National Park departs from Arusha at dawn.
The hotel has a Conference Center with a banqueting suite and five adaptable event rooms.

highlights.text: The hotel rises up among coffee and tea plantations.
Mount Meru View rooms have a balcony overlooking the Mount Meru volcano and the hotel gardens.
The hotel has an infinity pool, an outdoor swimming pool, a rooftop area and Bali beds.
The Spa and Wellness Centre offers health and beauty treatments inspired by a combination of traditions and modern wellness techniques.
The hotel offers a guided day trip into the Ngorongoro Crater, with a picnic lunch at the hippo pool.

considerations.text: The hotel is 48 km from the airport.
The hotel's guided excursions must be booked 48 hours in advance.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing that may not suit every budget.
